description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” illustrates the runtimes of five models evaluated in a streaming setting. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, ordered left to right as “Our Joint Framework,” “ChatGPT,” “DeepSeek,” “LLaMA,” and “Claude,” with labels shown at a slight angle; there is no separate x-axis label. The vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks every 50 seconds. There are five single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Our Joint Framework” is shown in dark green with an annotated value of 77 seconds; the remaining four bars are light blue (as indicated by the legend “LLM Models”) with annotated values of 190 seconds for “ChatGPT,” 365 seconds for “DeepSeek,” 172 seconds for “LLaMA,” and 243 seconds for “Claude.” Each bar has a black outline and a bold numeric label placed above its top, and the bars are presented in the listed categorical order rather than being sorted by height, with no additional visual emphasis beyond color and value annotations.
caption_used: The bar chart titled 'Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment' compares the runtime performance of various models on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, labeled as 'Our Joint Framework,' 'ChatGPT,' 'DeepSeek,' 'LLaMA,' and 'Claude,' ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, featuring a linear scale from 0 to 400, with tick intervals of 50 seconds. The green bar representing 'Our Joint Framework' has a runtime of approximately 77 seconds, while the light blue bars representing the other models have runtimes as follows: 'ChatGPT' at 190 seconds, 'DeepSeek' at 300 seconds, 'LLaMA' at 172 seconds, and 'Claude' at 243 seconds. Notably, 'DeepSeek' demonstrates a runtime reduction compared to 'Claude,' contrary to expectations based on model complexity. Additionally, 'ChatGPT' exhibits a runtime increase of nearly 20% compared to 'LLaMA,' suggesting potential inefficiencies in streaming environments. The numerical labels at the top of each bar provide clarity for runtime values.
